program.name: Floor Surprise
program.subject: Surprise
program.blurb: No gear, and every day a different subject, all twenty before any repeats.
program.about: Twenty subjects you can do on the floor, one a day. Bodyweight strength, push-ups, floor pulls, legs, glutes, shoulders, arms, HIIT, jumps, boxing, kickboxing, core, Pilates, yoga, mobility, balance, back care and more each come once before any comes back, each time in a different format. Abs finish the days that end in work, not in a stretch. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Every day a different subject · no equipment, short
